items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Some of the trumpet playing you thought might have been Lincoln Mills.

ctx.x: Yes, he brought his music in. All we had to do was just play it. He passed out the music, and we'd play it. It was written out, yeah. Now, what else?
Some of the trumpet playing you thought might have been Lincoln Mills.
Well, yeah, one number I heard, it sounds similar to Freddy Jenkins, but I would say it's not Freddy
